Researcher with 7 years in statistical modeling and machine learning, based in New York.

I am learning LLM post-training and evaluation in public. The questions I care about are
statistical ones: is a score difference real or noise, did the model see the test set,
and is the agent solving the task or gaming the grader.

Every number I publish comes from a script you can re-run.

## Projects

**[custom-tutor](https://github.com/YuxiaoDai/custom-tutor)** — a Claude Code skill that
merges several university courses into one personal study plan, then teaches, sets
exercises, and grades them.
